reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: createTempRegistrationInternal is called at actions.ts:121 by the exported createTempRegistration — not dead code. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; attack entry point is the unauthenticated kiosk NFC tap, which is an explicitly in-scope untrusted vector. Gate 3: src/app/actions.ts is in scope and 'Temporary registration token reuse or expiry bypass' is listed in key_security_concerns. Code confirmed (L161) unconditionally deletes all is_used=false rows for card_id and inserts a new token — replacement, not rejection — directly contradicting the spec assertion. An attacker can trigger this via the unauthenticated kiosk endpoint by submitting the same card_id as a legitimate user's pending registration, causing L161 to delete the victim's live QR token and issue a new one, silently invalidating the victim's in-progress registration flow. Severity held at Medium: requires physical kiosk access and knowledge/possession of the victim's card_id.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: SG-001: CreateTempRegistration must reject if an active (non-expired) temp_registration exists for card_id.
